entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf Planeswalker who fights the Eldrazi on Zendikar with the giant elemental Ashaya and learns she is one with Zendikar.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: A giant tree-like elemental sent by Zendikar that stays with Nissa and shows her the leylines through a repeated gesture.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: An old vampire who spoke of Nissa's spark and whose gifts of seeds the vampire envoy brings.

entities.name: The vampire envoy
entities.description: An unnamed vampire who knows Nissa's name and asks her to carry four seeds to another plane on Anowon's behalf.

entities.name: Hamadi
entities.description: An elf who called Nissa Shaya and believed she was meant to save the world.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane being consumed by the Eldrazi, whose soul connected to her through leylines.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monsters that leave white corruption and drain the life of all they touch.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose brood leaves trails of corruption.

entities.name: The Vastwood Forest
entities.description: The forest on Zendikar where Nissa and Ashaya fight.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: The destroyed continent of Nissa's home, source of the bloodbriar seed.

entities.name: The leylines
entities.description: Glowing lines of power flowing through Zendikar that Nissa learns to see.

entities.name: The kor warrior
entities.description: A kor who fights at the encampment and is consumed by the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
events.quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

events.summary: Nissa names the elemental Ashaya, the Awoken World, after Hamadi's name for her.
events.quote: "Okay then, Ashaya it is," Nissa said.

events.summary: Nissa questions why Zendikar chose her again after she failed the first time, and Ashaya repeats its confusing gesture.
events.quote: I failed. Last time you chose me, I failed.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya hear screams and see Eldrazi attacking a small encampment.
Nissa and Ashaya crush the first Eldrazi, fight the tentacled one and cripple it, but the third carries off the kor, who is consumed.
events.quote: the Eldrazi consumed the kor's life, turning her still, pale body into dust.

events.summary: A vampire consoles Nissa, reveals he knows her name and her spark, and tells her the world is ending.
events.quote: "That is fair considering your history with vampires, Nissa."

events.summary: The vampire offers four seeds from Anowon, including the last bloodbriar of Bala Ged, asking Nissa to take them to another plane.
Nissa takes the seeds as the vampire argues no effort can beat the titans; Ashaya watches, and the vampire vanishes.
Mimicking Ashaya's gesture, Nissa sees glowing leylines stream from her fingers and understands Zendikar did not choose her but she is one with it.
Nissa realizes she was never chosen or alone but one with Zendikar and cries 'For Zendikar!', charging into the forest bonded to the land.
Nissa and Ashaya kill the one-tentacled Eldrazi with a spear of land and a punch from Ashaya.
events.quote: The horror let out a final deflating chitter as it collapsed.

events.summary: Nissa rides Ashaya and calls an army of baloth-sized elementals as they hunt an Eldrazi titan.
events.quote: an army of baloth-sized elementals took shape.

relations.note: Ashaya fights beside her and is one with her through the leylines.
relations.quote: This was the line that connected Nissa to all that Ashaya was

relations.note: Devotes her life to fighting them.
relations.quote: Nissa has devoted her life to fighting the swarms of Eldrazi that plague her world.

relations.note: The elemental is part of Zendikar, sent by it to aid Nissa.
relations.quote: it manifests as a giant, tree-like elemental to aid her in battle

relations.note: Delivers the seeds as gifts from Anowon.
An elf who traveled with her and named her Shaya.
relations.quote: Since they had left the company of Hamadi and the other elves
the Eldrazi consumed the kor's life
